data.adjudication: Payment and client relationship documented; no evidence in the source that Zeldin participated in Menendez's crimes.
data.claim: Zeldin disclosed consulting work for Heritage Advisors, a firm led by a Qatari royal family member and connected to a transaction discussed in the Menendez corruption case. Heritage Advisors was not accused of wrongdoing in that case.
